copy.html:
These Promotional Terms & Conditions (“Promotion T&Cs”) apply to the Rewards Weekend Balance Promotion (“the Promotion”) offered by LottosOnline, operated by Marvicap Ltd. These Promotion T&Cs form part of, and are subject to, the LottosOnline General Terms & Conditions, which govern all player activity on the Website. In the event of conflict, the General Terms & Conditions shall prevail.

1. Eligibility

1.1 The Promotion is open to all registered LottosOnline Players who meet the eligibility requirements set out in the General Terms & Conditions, including being over 18 years of age.

1.2 Only one account per Player is permitted. Duplicate or fraudulent accounts will be suspended or removed, and any associated promotional benefits forfeited.

1.3 Players residing in restricted territories, as defined in the FAQ and General Terms, are not eligible to participate.

2. Promotional Period

2.1 The Promotion is valid only during the specific promotional period communicated by LottosOnline. As per current communications, the promotion runs from Friday 1st May 00:00 GMT until Monday 4th May at 23:59 GMT.

2.2 LottosOnline reserves the right to amend, extend, or withdraw the Promotion at any time without prior notice, in accordance with its general right to withdraw services .

3. How the Promotion Works

3.1 During the promotional period, Players will receive Rewards Balance on all qualifying cash ticket purchases.

3.2 A qualifying transaction is defined as:
  • A ticket purchase made using the Player’s Account Balance (cash funds)
3.3 Rewards Balance is not awarded on ticket purchases made using Rewards Balance funds, consistent with the rule that Rewards Balance may only be used to purchase tickets and is not withdrawable.

3.4 Rewards Balance is credited within two working days after the end of the promotion period.

4. Rewards Balance Usage

4.1 Rewards Balance may only be used to purchase ticket entries for lotteries and raffles offered on LottosOnline, as defined in the General Terms.

4.2 Rewards Balance cannot be withdrawn, transferred, or exchanged for cash.

4.3 Any winnings resulting from purchases made using Rewards Balance will be treated as normal winnings and processed in accordance with the standard winnings claims procedures.

5. Expiry of Rewards Balance

5.1 Rewards Balance earned through this Promotion is subject to the standard expiry rules: Rewards Balance expires if the Player has not made a purchase for more than 60 days.

5.2 Any Rewards Balance that expires is permanently forfeited.

6. Exclusions & Limitations

6.1 The Promotion is not connected to any other offer, including the Welcome Bonus or loyalty programme benefits.

6.2 The Promotion does not apply to:
  • Ticket purchases made using Rewards Balance
  • Withdrawals
  • Any transaction deemed fraudulent or abusive
6.3 LottosOnline reserves the right to cancel or reverse promotional credits in cases of suspected fraud, abuse, or breach of account rules, consistent with the General Terms regarding fraudulent activity and account misuse.

7. Account Requirements

7.1 Players must ensure their account information is accurate and up to date, as required under the General Terms.

7.2 Any suspected breach of account security must be reported immediately.

8. General Conditions

8.1 Participation in the Promotion constitutes acceptance of these Promotion T&Cs and the LottosOnline General Terms & Conditions.

8.2 LottosOnline is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from participation in the Promotion, in line with the general limitation of liability clause.

8.3 All decisions by LottosOnline regarding the Promotion are final.

8.4 The Promotion is governed by the laws of Cyprus, consistent with the governing law clause in the General Terms .

9. Contact

For any questions or disputes regarding the Promotion, Players must submit a written description of the issue to support@LottosOnline.com, as required under the General Terms for complaints and disputes.
